text:
Clara - Growth: Kickoff: StarterKit launch (tiny OSS refapp + 3 how-tos). Need blog, short benchmark narrative, webinar, gated LP + lead routing, and 6 socials. Volunteers?
Diego - DevRel: Ian own tutorials + demo clip. Will run a micro-bench for local vs hosted vs quantized. Keeping numbers rounded for marketing.
Priya - Content: I'll take the blog + social drafts. Tone: engineer-first, no hype. Two headline options: 'StarterKit: local to cloud, in minutes' or 'Ship an LLM feature fast'. Which lands?
Jonah - Design: I'll mock hero, 2 screenshots, and a 10s GIF. Need final headline + one-sentence TL;DR by Wed AM.
Mina - GrowthOps: Webinar proposal: Tue Sep 14, 10am PT. Landing page gated (email, role, company size). Webhook to HubSpot; tag by use-case. Auto-assign rules: >150 emp -> AE queue.
Clara - Growth: Benchmark blurbs: two lines max. Diego, can you provide median/p95 latency and an approximate cost multiplier for quantized configs?
Diego - DevRel: Provisional: local median ~95ms, hosted median ~130ms, hosted p95 ~420ms; quantized dedicated ~3x cheaper per-token. Will run final harness and share numbers + snippet.
Priya - Content: Social draft (X):
"StarterKit: a tiny OSS refapp to build & optimize LLM features locally + in the cloud. Try it, watch the webinar Sep 14. https://redwood.ai/starterkit #OSS #llm"
Jonah - Design: For benchmark visual, want a compact bar chart + small callouts. I'll export an optimized PNG for blog.
Mina - GrowthOps: Lead form fields: name, email, company, size, role, use-case, interested-in. Zapier -> HubSpot. Set properties: ref_starterkit=true, requested_demo if checked.
badge-bot: Artifact published: https://artifacts.redwood.ai/starterkit/v1.0/starterkit.tar.gz
Clara - Growth: Owners recap: Diego (tutorial + bench blurbs), Priya (blog + socials), Jonah (assets), Mina (webinar + routing). Publish target: Sep 14 AM blog + webinar same day.
Diego - DevRel: I'll PR demo + bench scripts by Mon EOD. Snippet to include in blog:
```
python bench.py --profile hosted --seq 128 --runs 100
```
Priya - Content: Blog outline: TL;DR, quickstart (3 steps), benchmark highlights (callouts + link to harness), how to contribute, webinar CTA. I'll post draft Tue.
Jonah - Design: Posting initial hero mock in #design-review now. Feedback welcome.
Mina - GrowthOps: I'll create LP and wire the webhook; will share test link for review.
Clara - Growth: Great. Small ask: include 1-2 short customer scenarios (edge dev, internal infra) in the blog. Diego, can you add those to the demo script?
Diego - DevRel: Yep, will add two scenario scripts in PR.
Clara - Growth: Thanks team 680
Closing thread 44d. Will post consolidated checklist and folder path tomorrow: /marketing/campaigns/starterkit/
